description: This file defines a configuration class for HuggingFace reranking API integration, including URL construction, parameter mapping, environment validation, response transformation, and credential management. It also defines related data types and error handling specific to the rerank process.

classes.name: HuggingFaceRerankResponseItem
classes.description: TypedDict defining individual response items from HuggingFace rerank API, including index, score, and optional text.

classes.name: HuggingFaceRerankResponse
classes.description: TypedDict representing the complete response from HuggingFace rerank API, primarily a list of response items.

classes.name: HuggingFaceRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class inheriting from BaseRerankConfig, providing methods for URL construction, parameter mapping, environment validation, response transformation, error handling, and credential retrieval specific to HuggingFace rerank API.

methods.name: get_api_base
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the API, defaulting to environment variables or a fixed URL if none are set.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL including the /rerank suffix.

methods.name: get_supported_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for the rerank API.

methods.name: map_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Maps user-provided parameters to the API-specific parameter names.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and returns headers with proper authorization for API requests.

methods.name: transform_rerank_request
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into the request body for the API call, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: transform_rerank_response
methods.description: Processes the raw API response, estimates token usage, and formats the response into the internal RerankResponse structure.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns a specific exception class for errors encountered during API interaction.

methods.name: get_api_credentials
methods.description: Retrieves API key and base URL from multiple sources, prioritizing direct input, environment variables, and secrets.
